input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: Argument.get_help_record returns self.help unchanged, so the second element of the tuple is None for an undocumented argument even though format_arguments now feeds every record straight into formatter.write_dl without a fallback.
- failure path: A command declares two arguments and sets help on only one; running it with --help makes write_dl measure and wrap a None description and the help command crashes with a TypeError instead of printing usage.

Reviewer finding
- description: Undocumented arguments return `(metavar, None)` instead of `(metavar, "")`. With the formatter's fallback removed, this causes help rendering to fail.
- rationale: When a command has one argument with help text and another whose help is unset, the positional arguments section is rendered for both. The undocumented argument now passes None as its description to formatter.write_dl, whose string-width calculation raises TypeError. Users requesting --help receive an exception instead of help output.
critique: The finding names the same mechanism: get_help_record returns None for an undocumented argument's help, format_arguments no longer applies a fallback, and write_dl raises a TypeError on the None description. It also describes the same trigger, a mix of documented and undocumented arguments under --help, so it matches the labeled defect.
